name: quire-ink
description: The reading surface of the Quire Ink blog engine, as a Ghost theme.

palette.description: The colours the site opens in. All six ship in the stylesheet.

reader_can_change_palette.description: Offer the other five palettes to readers, remembered on their device.

default_scheme.description: What a first-time visitor sees before they choose for themselves.

terminal_chrome.description: Bracketed tokens instead of icons, and numbered rail rows.

book_typography.description: Indented paragraphs, justified lines, hyphenation at the break.

list_thumbnails.description: Where a post's feature image goes in the list: beside or above the words.

post_feature_image.description: Show a post's feature image above its headline.

show_tagline.description: The site description, under the site name.

footer_credit.description: One line naming the theme, at the foot of the page.
